svg.text: Guarded Transitions (ADR 0007): Every status change is a compare-and-set — the row is locked (FOR UPDATE / SKIP LOCKED),

text.font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: moves only if its current status is in the allowed from-set, and writes its notification_events audit row in the same SQL statement.
